notes: Warm-up: 8-10 min easy row/bike + barbell-only ramp-up sets before the Deadlift block. Per R26, keep >=48h from any other heavy hinge or heavy overhead-press session; treat the next day as lower-intensity/rest (R21).

name: Power Clean + Front Squat (olympic power day)

name: Norwegian 4x4 Bike Intervals

name: True Tabata Bike Protocol
notes: Warm-up: 5-8 min easy bike. Single movement only, supramaximal intensity -- this is the actual validated Tabata protocol (R12), unlike the pool's other mixed-movement 20/10 circuits.
